name: Collar Multicolor Ariana Grande x Swarovski
short: Descubre la armonía perfecta entre color y luz con este collar multicolor de Swarovski, una pieza bañada en rodio que despliega un brillo cristalino y delicados tonos pastel. Su diseño ajustable permite llevarlo como collar o gargantilla, convirtiéndolo en una joya versátil que ilumina cualquier estilo.
description: This necklace from the Ariana Grande x Swarovski collection showcases a graceful interplay of light and colour through its rhodium plated craftsmanship and uniform strand of clear Swarovski Zirconia, delivering a refined, luminous finish. Beneath the piece, pastel hued crystals in mixed cuts hang delicately, adding movement and a feminine, expressive charm. Thanks to its adjustable mechanism, it can be worn long or shortened into a choker, adapting seamlessly to both everyday outfits and more elevated looks. A versatile and inspirational jewel that pairs beautifully with the matching bracelet from the same family.
